Key references and open-access sources for filling out the Comparative Engineering Record (summarized for use):

### Direct Drive Modular Humanoid Robots
- **Low-cost modular actuator design:**  
  *Duckitt & de Freitas, 2025. [Design of a low-cost modular actuator for humanoid robotics](https://www.matec-conferences.org/articles/matecconf/pdf/2025/11/matecconf_rapdasa2025_04001.pdf).*  
  - Multiple brushed DC motors + planetary gearbox. Focus on cost, manufacturability, and modularity.
- **Comprehensive drive comparison:**  
  *Wang et al., 2021. [Survey on Main Drive Methods Used in Humanoid Robotic Upper Limbs](https://downloads.spj.sciencemag.org/cbsystems/2021/9817487.pdf).*  
  - Compares direct, tendon, and hybrid approaches (criteria: weight, output, efficiency).
- **Open platform examples:**  
  *NimbRo-OP and NimbRo-OP2 ([arXiv:1809.11051v1](http://arxiv.org/abs/1809.11051v1), [arXiv:1809.11144v1](http://arxiv.org/abs/1809.11144v1))*: Designs, components, cost cues for direct drive and hybrid approaches in open research robots.

### Hybrid Actuation (Series/Parallel, Tendon + Gear, etc.)
- **Survey on modular/hybrid robots:**  
  *Kumar et al., 2020. [A survey on modularity and distributivity in series-parallel hybrid robots](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0957415820300477/pdf).*  
  - Outlines use cases for hybrid actuation and load distribution in modular systems.
- **Specialized parallel/hybrid actuation:**  
  *Tanaka et al., 2025. [Mechanical Intelligence-Aware Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Humanoids with Parallel Actuation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00273v3).*  
  - Discussion of design/simulation and advantages/drawbacks.
